Hackers rapidly exploit the Atlassian vulnerability CVE-2026-21589. Learn how this critical flaw compromises Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket

via Mastodon https://meterpreter.org/atlassian-cve-2026-21589-vulnerability/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-21589.evidence: Aggregator headline claims hackers are rapidly exploiting CVE-2026-21589 in the wild, but the source is low quality and mislabels affected products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket vs Bamboo), so treat as unconfirmed.
